name: synthetic_features
description: Emits a rich, deterministic FAKE feature set from a seed — to stress the extractor/constructor + nominal-type wiring with nested records, typed arrays, and a custom nominal type. No image processing.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.doc: Drives the fake data. REQUIRED — missing → NA.

inputs.name: roi
inputs.doc: Optional region; echoed back in the output.

outputs.name: roi
outputs.doc: Echoed input ROI (or a default frame ROI).
